comment: The one list of what the launcher does. scripts/sync-features.py writes README.md and the website from it. summary says what a feature does, and standing, where a feature has it, says how far along it is. The README shows each feature's status with its summary and standing. The website lists every feature with its summary alone. Status is one of: available (works in the app today), in-progress (code exists or is being written, not usable in the app yet), planned.

features.title: Liquid Glass panel
features.summary: A native macOS Liquid Glass panel.

features.title: Fuzzy search
features.summary: Find results by partial name, abbreviation or typo.

features.title: Learns your habits
features.summary: Choose a result twice for the same search to move it to the top.

features.title: Suggestions before you type
features.summary: Get suggestions based on the time of day and the apps you use.

features.title: Apps and System Settings
features.summary: Open, quit or reveal apps and jump to System Settings panes.

features.title: Hotkeys, aliases and favorites
features.summary: Assign keyboard shortcuts and aliases, or pin items as favorites.

features.title: Themes
features.summary: Choose from seven themes and adjust the glass, colors and text size.

features.title: Action panel
features.summary: Press Command-K for actions on the selected result.

features.title: Updates
features.summary: Optional daily update checks. You choose when to install.
features.standing: Version 0.1.1 is the first update it offers to people who installed 0.1.0.

features.title: File search
features.summary: Search files by name and browse folders.

features.title: Calculator
features.summary: Calculate, convert units and currencies, and work with dates and time zones. Return copies the answer.

features.title: Clipboard history
features.summary: Find and paste text, links, images and files you copied.

features.title: Snippets
features.summary: Save text with placeholders and paste it when you need it.

features.title: Window management
features.summary: Resize, center and move windows between displays.

features.title: System commands
features.summary: Lock or sleep your Mac, adjust volume, eject disks and quit processes.

features.title: Quicklinks and web search
features.summary: Open websites or search the web with a keyword.

features.title: Emoji picker
features.summary: Find emoji and symbols by name, then paste them.

features.title: Script commands
features.summary: Run scripts with arguments and view their output.

features.title: Universal actions
features.summary: Run actions on text or files selected in another app.

features.title: Dictionary
features.summary: Look up definitions and check spelling.

features.title: Calendar and reminders
features.summary: Check your calendar, join meetings and create events or reminders.

features.title: Contacts
features.summary: Find contacts to call, message or email.

features.title: Browser bookmarks
features.summary: Search and open bookmarks from Safari, Chrome and Firefox.

features.title: Menu items
features.summary: Find and run menu commands in the current app.

features.title: AI
features.summary: Ask questions using Apple’s on-device model or a provider you configure.

features.title: Shell commands
features.summary: Type > to run a shell command and see its output.

features.title: Notes
features.summary: Write, search and organize notes saved as Markdown files.
features.standing: A floating note window is not part of it.

features.summary: Play, pause and skip tracks in Music and Spotify.
